name: ide-zig
author: lumine-code
description: Provide Zig language features with ZLS.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to the native ZLS executable. Leave empty to use the managed copy, then PATH.

zigPath.title: Zig Path
zigPath.description: Absolute path to the Zig SDK executable. Leave empty to use PATH. Zig and ZLS must share their major and minor version.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer to install ZLS when it or a matching Zig SDK is missing.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which ZLS features the editor uses. ZON supplies diagnostics, formatting and semantic tokens; Zig supplies the remaining features.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report Zig syntax, AST checks and optional build findings.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete Zig symbols, imports and builtins.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show function parameters while entering calls.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to Zig declarations and resolved types.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename Zig symbols across project source.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Apply AST-check fixes and source actions.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show inferred types and parameter names.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Classify Zig and ZON using semantic information.

buildOnSave.title: Build On Save
buildOnSave.description: Run compiler checks after saving. Server Default respects ZLS automatic detection of the project check step.

parameterHints.title: Parameter Hints
parameterHints.description: Show argument names inline. Server Default preserves the project and ZLS configuration.
